title: The Architect of False Ambition
intro: A figure of great authority once served one of history's most notorious tyrants in ancient Egypt. This individual was entrusted with an audacious command — to construct a structure meant to defy the heavens. Their story stands in the Quran as a striking lesson about how blind obedience to arrogance leads only to ruin.
clues: I served in the courts of a powerful ruler who claimed divinity over the lands.
I held a high ministerial position, advising the most arrogant tyrant of my time.
My ruler was consumed with challenging the God of Moses, whom they refused to acknowledge.
I was commanded to construct a tower of fire-baked bricks so my ruler could ascend to the heavens.
The tower never reached the sky, and my servitude to arrogance earned me eternal disgrace.
I perished with the one I followed, and my name became a lasting warning against those who enable tyrants.
